dogecoin.text: #Dogecoin in spotlight as cryptocurrency backer ⁦@elonmusk⁩ makes 'SNL' appearance | Reuters https://t.co/7DarMf9jf5

Nic Carter's first foray into digital currencies was mining #Dogecoin in his university dorm room back in 2013. Created as a #joke with the Shiba Inu dog breed as its logo, the meme-inspired token seemed more fun than #Bitcoin and its community of diehards.
@elonmusk tweets about #dogecoin and everybody laps it up 🐶
